name: Cafe Marea
notes: Could not confirm this business exists at the given address. Separately, a gluten-free dining database describes a 'Cafe Marea' as a breakfast/sandwich cafe (7am-3pm) that took over a former 'Rubicon Deli' space at 3819 Mission Blvd - a different address in the same general neighborhood. That 3819 Mission Blvd address has since cycled through multiple other concepts (California SA Deli - CLOSED, Surfing Bear Sandwich - CLOSED, currently Mission Baja Tacos), with no current business called Cafe Marea. Neither candidate address currently operates as 'Cafe Marea'. Rather than load Oltre Mare's real Italian dinner menu onto a listing for what was evidently a breakfast/sandwich cafe (wrong business), or guess at a permanently-closed cafe's stale menu, this is recorded as not-found.

name: Sun Deck
notes: Located at the Hotel del Coronado, matches work item address exactly. The 'SEE MENUS' link on the restaurant's own page embeds a SinglePlatform widget (places.singleplatform.com/sundeck/menu) that lists dozens of items across For The Table, Handhelds, Enhancements, Sides, Kids Bites and other sections - but only ONE item on the entire embedded menu carries a price; every other item (Chips & Salsa Trio, Del Beach Empanadas, Baja Shrimp Cocktail, The Del Double Cheeseburger, Spice-Crusted Fish Sandwich, etc.) has a name and description with no dollar figure anywhere in the page's DOM. A third-party menuweb.menu PDF exists with what would be full pricing, but it is an aggregator template (not the restaurant's own document) with no independent corroboration, and was not used per the trust ladder. Per the no-price rule, only the one genuinely priced item is recorded; this is a real but very thin capture, not a representative sample of the menu.
